prompt: What game are we making: title, premise, player goal, genre, audience, and the scope of this first delivery?
guidance: Reuse supplied answers. Ask for missing creative fields as free text. Offer a small playable slice as a recommendation only when it fits the brief.

prompt: Which presentation and camera should this game use?
guidance: Offer relevant 2D, 3D or 2.5D choices. For 2.5D resolve rendering and simulation separately. Resolve orientation, viewport, pixel style and applicable tile or sprite settings.

prompt: What visual direction and asset quality should guide the game?
guidance: Resolve style and references, palette, lighting, views, expressions, clips and asset budgets. Explain a recommendation against the target hardware and gameplay camera.

prompt: Which platforms and minimum hardware should we target, and at what frame rate?
guidance: Offer macOS and iOS first as Recommended when no conflicting target is supplied. Resolve minimum OS, device, engine version, renderer and memory budget. Technical values may be inferred from a pipeline proof and recorded before ready.

prompt: Which controls and accessibility options should the game support?
guidance: Resolve keyboard, mouse, controller and touch, touch placement, side swapping, rebinding and accessibility. Offer choices relevant to the target devices.

prompt: Which image and asset providers, models and quality settings may each production stage use?
guidance: Offer GPT Image 2.5 for concepts, with Flare as the default for exploration and routine generation and Sunburst for precise edits or polished final artwork. Use references/providers.md for flavor selection and tool availability rules. Offer SpriteCook for 2D assets when connected, local Blender for 3D work, local procedural audio for music and sound effects, and Higgsfield only if needed. Resolve provider-default versus explicit model per purpose, permitted fallbacks, and computer use only when needed.

prompt: What cash and provider-credit limits should apply to this project?
guidance: Resolve cash, SpriteCook and Higgsfield credits separately, retry limits and concurrent paid jobs. Preselected values are suggestions until submitted. Zero means no authorized spend in that category.

prompt: Which supporting features belong in this delivery?
guidance: Resolve players/network, saves, languages, audio, monetization and content constraints. When audio is in scope, also ask for its aesthetic in words (genre, era, mood, sound palette) so the audio direction can define a distinct sonic identity. Ask only about relevant possibilities and record accepted exclusions.

prompt: How independently should production run, and which review or delivery checkpoints should it use?
guidance: Resolve assisted or unattended work, who selects concepts and reviews assets, permitted parallelism, tracker, quality priority and delivery/signing. Explain that user review checkpoints cause an unattended run to wait at those points.

prompt: May we use the detected repository layout or the proposed GameGen starter layout?
guidance: Present the actual detected paths. Keep existing project layout by default and mark that choice Recommended. An earlier request to preserve or use a path already resolves it.
